Method

How the experiment works

Three model families
Linear quantile regression, gradient-boosted quantile regression and a random-forest tree distribution are compared against a no-change baseline.
Honest timing
Each rolling forecast trains only on targets whose assumed publication date is no later than the forecast date. HS codes are never pooled.
Calibrated uncertainty
Pre-test residuals provide a split-conformal expansion for the P05-P95 range. Quantiles are monotonically ordered after prediction.

Specification deviation: this experiment uses ONS ERUC as the added external metal-inflation feature. It does not include the specification's World Bank aluminium/nickel or USGS titanium-sponge inputs. Results therefore assess the approved ERUC feature substitution, not literal full-spec compliance.
